stem.text: On complete combustion, a sample of X produces $44\,\text{g}$ of carbon dioxide and $27\,\text{g}$ of water.
On complete combustion, a sample of Y produces $44\,\text{g}$ of carbon dioxide and $18\,\text{g}$ of water.
On complete combustion, a sample of Z produces $22\,\text{g}$ of carbon dioxide and $9\,\text{g}$ of water.
Which substances could be straight chain alkanes?
